_comment: Global tuning constants. Read through GameData.rule(key, default).
_supply_comment: Supply (step 11): divisions in provinces not connected to their capital through friendly territory lose attrition_per_day x max HP and attrition_org_per_day x max organization each day and do not recover.
_combat_comment: Strategic combat (step 10), resolved once per in-game day. damage = combat_damage_scale x side attack x clamp(side attack / enemy defense, combat_ratio_min, combat_ratio_max), split evenly over the enemy divisions; each point costs combat_org_per_damage organization and combat_hp_per_damage HP. Division strength factor = 1 - combat_hp_strength_weight x (1 - hp / max hp). Entrenchment grows entrenchment_per_day for divisions that are not moving (max 1) and adds up to entrenchment_defense_bonus to defense. Out of battle divisions recover org_recovery_per_day x max organization and (in own territory) hp_recovery_per_day x max HP each day.
